title: Paper Moths
label: Simple
prompt: A paper-screen parlor game where pale moths settle on a warm lantern and you tap them before they lift off, with a soft ink-wash background and a forty-second dusk timer.

title: Gate Comet
label: Simple
prompt: A single comet looping a dark ring, and you tap only while it crosses a glowing gate arc, tightening the window as the orbit speeds up.

title: Lantern Stack
label: Simple
prompt: Lanterns drop from a swaying line and you click to set each one on the stack below, keeping the overlap or the tower narrows until it tips.

title: Moss Steps
label: Simple
prompt: A firefly hops a line of mossy stepping stones over dark water, and you tap to jump only when a stone is under the glow, scoring each new stone before the current one slides away.

title: Wick Line
label: Simple
prompt: A candle flame travels a horizontal wick, and you tap while it crosses a gold band, with the window tightening until three late cuts put the candle out.

title: Roofline Crane
label: Mid
prompt: A paper crane flaps through a night of tiled eaves, gravity pulling between roof gaps, with parallax clouds, a soft flap burst, and a best score that stays on this browser.

title: Upstream Koi
label: Mid
prompt: An endless side-on koi run upstream: the fish keeps moving, you leap over river stones and duck hanging nets, snatch gold scales, and the current gets faster.

title: Kiln Break
label: Mid
prompt: A kiln breakout: a clay paddle slides under a glowing ball, bricks fire from pale to cracked across two hits, and a wider paddle shard sometimes falls.

title: Orchard Serpent
label: Mid
prompt: A serpent in an orchard grid eats fruit to grow, but every third fruit sprouts a blossom wall from the edge, and a rare moon pear lets the body turn ghost for a few seconds.

title: Belt Drift
label: Mid
prompt: A small skiff in an asteroid belt: rotate and thrust to slip between rocks, score near misses when a stone passes close, three hull hits and the run ends, and the screen wraps.

title: Pulse Lanterns
label: Mid
prompt: A four-lane rhythm tap where lantern beats fall to a line at a steady 120, with D F J K or a tap on the lane, perfect and good windows, and the combo breaks on a miss.

title: Loom Shuttle
label: Mid
prompt: A shuttle races three loom lanes, and you shift it up or down to meet the open warp, scoring each row that clears.

title: Tide Bell
label: Mid
prompt: A listener on a night shore turns to face bells that ring in a circle before each tone fades, with three listens.

title: Pier Watch
label: Advanced
prompt: A pier tower defense: boats follow a fixed water path, you spend coin on lantern towers, slow buoys, and splash bells in marked pads, upgrade once, and hold the dock across eight waves of skiffs and barges.

title: Courier of Glass
label: Advanced
prompt: A top-down courier across three hand-drawn floors of a glass archive: move and dash, dodge patrolling wardens that chase when you are close, find keys for locked doors, and gather three glass shards before a three-minute dusk timer.

title: Soot Lantern
label: Advanced
prompt: A lantern bearer crosses a soot-stained room maze before the oil burns out, collecting drops that refill the glass, avoiding closing shutters, and reaching the exit stair.

title: Night Press
label: Advanced
prompt: A letterpress shows a short word, and you tap falling type in order before they pass the platen, with longer words each round.

title: Neon Tetris
label: Mid
prompt: A neon tetromino stacker: pieces fall on a classic 10×20 well, arrow keys move and soft-drop, up rotates, space hard-drops, cleared lines score, and speed climbs with level.

title: Vault Dash
label: Mid
prompt: An endless neon vault runner: the courier auto-runs through a glowing corridor, you jump over crates and slide under lasers, grab score orbs, and the track accelerates until one miss ends the run.

title: Spark Climb
label: Simple
prompt: A spark climbs floating neon platforms: left and right to run, space or up to jump, land on rising pads, avoid falling off the screen, and climb as high as you can for score.
